description.p: Robot-independent tooling for replaying an optimized gait inside the SPlisHSPlasH fluid simulation.

Contains the Gazebo plugin that prescribes a published JointTrajectory, the node that turns an OCP solution .npz into that trajectory, and the collision-mesh exporter the fluid plugin needs. Which robot they act on comes from the registry in stage1_gait_optimization/hydro_model/robots and from the solution file itself, so no robot is named here and the robot description packages carry no copies.
